# DrugFuture

> A comprehensive pharmaceutical data platform aggregating FDA, EMA, and Chinese drug databases with patent search capabilities for researchers and industry professionals.

DrugFuture provides unified access to major regulatory drug databases including FDA Orange Book, NDC codes, EMA medicines, and Chinese drug registries, alongside international patent search tools. The platform serves pharmaceutical researchers, regulatory professionals, and industry stakeholders seeking drug approval status, bioequivalence data, and intellectual property information.

## Key Topics

- FDA Drug Database
- Orange Book
- NDC (National Drug Code)
- EMA Medicines
- Chinese Drug Registration
- Patent Search
- Drug Approval
- Bioequivalence
- Orphan Drugs
- Drug Regulatory Data
- Generic Drugs
- Clinical Trials
- Pharmaceutical Standards
- Patent Database
- Drug Information

## Core Drug Databases

- [DrugFuture Homepage](https://www.drugfuture.com): Comprehensive drug database with FDA, EMA, Orange Book, NDC data
- [U.S. FDA Drug Database](https://www.drugfuture.com/fda): U.S. FDA drug database with approval status, bioequivalence, orphan drugs, and comprehensive drug information
- [Chinese Marketed Drugs Database](https://www.drugfuture.com/cndrug): Chinese marketed drugs database: State Food and Drug Administration registry, domestic and imported drugs
- [Drug Data Hub](https://www.drugfuture.com/drugdata): FDA Orange/Purple Book, EMA medicines, generic drugs, and therapeutic equivalence data

## Regulatory Reference Data

- [FDA Orange Book Database](https://www.drugfuture.com/fda/orangebook.aspx): Approved products with therapeutic equivalence evaluations and bioequivalent drug products
- [FDA NDC Database](https://www.drugfuture.com/fda-ndc): National drug codes, labeling information, and drug identification data
- [Chemical Index Database](https://www.drugfuture.com/chemdata): CAS registry, molecular structure, and chemical compound information for pharmaceutical substances

## Patent Search & Intellectual Property

- [Patent Data Hub](https://www.drugfuture.com/patent): China, US, and Europe patents with Orange Book and NDC pharmaceutical data
- [U.S. Patent Download](https://www.drugfuture.com/uspat/us_patent.asp): Full-text PDF patent search and download from USPTO
- [Chinese Patent Download](https://www.drugfuture.com/cnpat/cn_patent.asp): PDF format bulk download from CNIPA database
- [European Patent Download](https://www.drugfuture.com/eppat/patent.asp): PCT, WIPO patents, and international patent database access

## News & Updates

- [Pharmaceutical News](https://www.drugfuture.com/news): FDA approvals, gene therapy, cell therapy updates, and industry regulatory news
- [EMA-FDA AI Collaboration](https://www.drugfuture.com/news/202601/15726.html): EMA-FDA collaboration on AI principles for drug lifecycle development
- [EMA 2025 Drug Approvals](https://www.drugfuture.com/news/202601/15725.html): Gene therapy, biosimilars, orphan drugs, and breakthrough therapy approvals

## Educational Resources

- [Pharmaceutical Topics](https://www.drugfuture.com/topic): FDA guidelines, drug registration procedures, and regulatory information
- [Reference Library](https://www.drugfuture.com/library): FDA/CFDA drug registry, patent search resources, research guidelines, and standards

## Access & Navigation

- [Mobile Portal](https://www.drugfuture.com/mobile): FDA/EMA drug approval news, clinical trials, and rare disease information
- [User Registration](https://www.drugfuture.com/reg.html): Member signup, account creation, and terms of service
- [Site Map](https://www.drugfuture.com/map.html): Navigation guide to FDA, EMA, HMA, PMDA drug databases and patent search tools
